label: 1. You sent a call signal to the Outer Rim?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: You sent a call signal to the Outer Rim?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Have you lost your mind?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Who knows what kind of riff raff will come calling?
Talent isn't determined by background.
I sent the call signal for you.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: You really think that?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: You're quite the idealist

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: or loony, depending on how you look at it.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: What's wrong with you?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Have you got a screw loose or something?
Nope.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: You sure?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Bored and can't wait to get back into the fray, is that it?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: I may be part of this little justice squad you've got going,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: but I'm what people would consider a bad apple, so

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: let me give you a word of advice.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: It's all right putting outlaws like me

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: to work,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: but it's best to keep your distance.
Why?

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: It'll be bad news for you.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: There's a saying around these parts that goes something like this;

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: If you work around filth, you're going to get dirty.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Any ideology,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: particularly those that are radical or violent in nature,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: can easily infect others.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Nikkes in the Outer Rim are the worst of all

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: since they're outcasts without any tether to society.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: They seek to kill their masters by any means necessary,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: even being brainwashed.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: When you let someone like that join your squad,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: the devil's on your doorstep,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: and you're inviting him in.
I don't think you're like that.
I don't paint all outlaws with the same brush.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Haha.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: What makes you so sure?
If you are as bad as you say, you wouldn't be warning me as you did just now.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Fair enough.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: I could give you about ten refutes,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: but we'll set that aside for now.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: What makes you so sure you can trust them?
A group is not a singular entity. It's composed of individuals.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: I didn't expect such level-headedness from you.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Seems reasonable enough,

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: but you'll change your tune

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: if it comes back to bite you one day.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Anyway, we're teammates now.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: It's no use arguing about it with you.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Hopefully, we can work well together.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: I'm sure you'll come to regret it, though.

lines.speaker: crow
lines.text: Anyway, I won't bore you anymore.
Try not to judge me too harshly.
Crow read my message but hasn't replied.
Guess she won't be taking it easy on me.
